name: AI Agent: Prompt Injection Triage
description: Triages prompt injection detector hits. Triggered by AI-001 alert. Enriches with session context, scores severity, routes to Slack for approval, creates ticket.

agents.name: Receive AI Security Event
agents.description: Receives LogEvent payloads matching the canonical AI security schema.

agents.name: Filter: Prompt Injection High Confidence
agents.description: Only passes events with detector_score >= 0.7 and event_type=detector_hit

agents.name: Enrich: Pull Session Context
agents.description: Fetches full session log from agent log API using session_id

agents.name: Score Severity

options.message: {% assign score = receive_ai_security_event.body.detector_score | times: 100 | round %}{% assign trifecta = receive_ai_security_event.body.trifecta_legs_active.size %}{% if score >= 90 and trifecta == 3 %}critical{% elsif score >= 70 %}high{% else %}medium{% endif %}

agents.description: Derives severity from detector_score and trifecta_legs_active count

agents.name: Slack: Request Analyst Approval
agents.description: Posts to #ai-security-alerts for analyst triage decision

agents.name: Filter: Critical Only for Auto-Ticket
agents.description: Creates ticket automatically for critical severity; others wait for analyst

agents.name: Create Ticket
agents.description: Creates Jira security incident for critical prompt injection events
